title: JAIP integrated leadership analytics
classification: questionnaire-derived metric contract; no completed response dataset supplied
sourceFiles: Key Informant Interview (KII) Survey – Jigawa State.pdf
JAIP – Integrated Leadership Analytics & Investment Planning Framework (user-supplied pasted text)

grain.FGD: one group discussion, not a household count
grain.KII: one informant interview, not a household count
grain.ENT: one enterprise interview, not deduplicated business entities

inclusion: approved records; mode actual excludes all demo records; examples contains only fictional records; apply role scope then all visible filters
filters: capture date from/to inclusive (created date fallback)

measures.formula: count of target LGAs with >=1 included interview / count target LGAs in role/geographic scope
measures.limitation: coverage is not priority or population prevalence

measures.formula: records selecting option / records with nonmissing answer
measures.limitation: multi-select counts may exceed denominator; no sampling weights

measures.formula: unweighted mean(loss) over valid 0<=loss<=100 HH answers
measures.limitation: not total losses or a state estimate
no midpoint imputation; no exact ROI, margin or peak/lean change from bands

measures.qualityFlag: reported profit differs from computed by >max(NGN1000,2% of revenue)
measures.limitation: optional self-reported proposed fields; not audited financial verification or loan approval; keep periods separate

measures.formula: monthlyOutput/installedMonthlyCapacity when capacity>0 and same stated unit
measures.limitation: never sum different units/commodities; output>installed flags review

measures.formula: sum supplemental unique headcounts across reporting enterprises; do not sum overlapping worker-category counts
measures.limitation: a worker may appear in multiple businesses; not unique statewide employment
do not infer business ownership from respondent gender or age
hypothetical scenario only; no enterprise scoring/eligibility/funding automation
illustrative fixed capacity; assumes demand, labour, inputs and infrastructure

sourceAdaptations.numericWorkerCounts: supplement, do not reinterpret original Q25 checkboxes
sourceAdaptations.inputQuantity: supplement quantity/unit/period; preserve Q40 frequency choices
sourceAdaptations.exclusiveAnswers: specified status/financial-band questions adapted from checkboxes to single choice, marked cardinalityAdapted
sourceAdaptations.applicability: Q8,19,71 conditional; source required flags preserved in source mapping

access: Server-verified leadership accounts only; approved records retrieved from shared server storage. Examples are explicitly fictional.
